description:
You need to cool it
It’s simple
The meaning of life.
The meaning of life,
Is to do things 
That earn you grief
From everyone left behind when you cark it.
Not to earn grief
But to do things
That do.

Who are you grieving?
Do it long and painful.
They earned it.

Sam
transcript: Jenny still had five days to live here. I laugh a little resentfully when I see other content creators apologize for not posting for a while because if I don't see a creator, I just assume the algorithm has taken them away for a while because I didn't give them enough attention. But it feels like important context that I didn't post because Jenny had five days to live and every moment I could find went to making her comfortable, hopefully happy. I haven't even shaved because before I was so busy trying to make her last days happy and now I'm saving energy for things that matter and my appearance doesn't really. And meanwhile the world goes on. Meanwhile I need to run a business and keep a roof over my head and I just keep sitting at my desk and staring at my hands as I fiddle with whatever these things are called. And meanwhile capitalism announces my place in the machinery of progress, and I wonder about how grief is supposed to happen. And I remember that for most of human history, from well before we started building cities, it probably wasn't alone in an apartment with another cat. Bug. Wandering from room to room, calling for Jenny in a way he never has has before even though he smelled her dead body and saw that she was gone and because i feel weird about making videos about anything but good procrastination advice next time you are overwhelmed by grief you will want to numb and when you can't be with people you you will need to, so procrastination will happen. And next to grieving the loss of something you found impossibly precious, that's fine. Procrastinate and grieve.
